name: claude-open
description: Click a file path in one of Claude's replies and it opens in a herdr pane to the right: markdown in leaf, anything else in $EDITOR, one pane reused. Needs function hooks (early access) and the fullscreen terminal (clicks); outside herdr it falls back to `open`.

viewers.title: Viewers by extension
viewers.description: JSON object, extension to shell command, {file} and {line} filled in, `*` for the rest. Merged over the defaults: {"md": "leaf -w {file}", "*": "${EDITOR:-vi} +{line} {file}"}.

focus.title: Focus the viewer pane
focus.description: Move the keyboard to the new pane when a file opens. Off: the focus stays on Claude.

herdr.title: herdr command
herdr.description: The herdr executable to call; `herdr` on PATH when empty.
